Ava Patel: Quick quarterly patterns sync — I scanned last 90 days for recurring incident signatures. Posting a short list and proposed owners.

Ava Patel: Recurring buckets:
• GPU cold-start spikes on scale-up
• KV/prefix cache rebuild storms
• Autoscaler oscillation on noisy pools
• Rare quantized decode stalls for long streams
• Rate-limiter bursts hitting routed customers

Jon Chen: Please share the aggregation query so SRE can reproduce.

Ava Patel: Simple metrics query I used:
`SELECT signal, count(*) as hits, p95(latency) from infra.events where ts > now() - interval '90 days' group by signal order by hits desc;`

Priya Singh: I'll own KV/prefix rebuilds. Plan: synthetic replay to repro, trace rebuild path, prototype stale-serving fallback gated by a flag. ETA: repro + POA by next Thu (1755009840).

Zoe Martinez: I'll pair on the fallback and safety checks. ETA: flag + doc by next Mon (1755009600).

Jon Chen: I'll take autoscaler thrash. Short fix: bump stabilization to 90s, cap instant bursts, add oscillation alert. PR by Tue (1755004500).

Maya Kaur: GPU warmup — I'll correlate with driver versions and scale events. If driver regressions show up, propose warmup preload. ETA: initial findings by EOW.

IncidentBot: Created INC-2065 for "KV prefix rebuild - recurring" and linked.

Ava Patel: Actions recap:
- Priya: INC-2065 repro + POA (ETA next Thu).
- Zoe: fallback flag + doc (ETA next Mon).
- Jon: autoscaler config PR + monitor (ETA Tue).
- Maya/Ava: GPU traces & driver correlation (ETA EOW).
- Model infra: escalate if quantized stalls persist; create INC-2066 if rollback needed.

Ava Patel: 15-min sync next Wed to confirm progress; otherwise post updates here. :calendar:

Jon Chen: +1, will post PR link.

Priya Singh: Will share initial repro logs in INC-2065.

Zoe Martinez: Adding pairing checklist to the ticket.

Ava Patel: Thanks everyone — appreciate fast ownership. If urgent, ping #eng-oncall. :pray:
